name: Sidebar
description: Production dashboard sidebar: header with collapse control, grouped navigation with badges and sub-menus, and an account footer. Renders fixed on desktop and inside a drawer on phone widths.

fields.iconSize: double? - navigation and header icon size, default 16
fields.borderColor: ThemedColor? - rail edge border, default sidebarBorder
fields.activeBackground: ThemedColor? - selected row fill, default sidebarAccent
fields.activeForeground: ThemedColor? - selected row foreground, default sidebarAccentForeground
fields.groupLabelColor: ThemedColor? - group label colour, default mutedForeground
fields.itemRadius: BorderRadiusGeometry? - row corner radius, default theme.borderRadiusMd
fields.surfaceOpacity: double? - frosted-glass opacity leg, default opaque
fields.surfaceBlur: double? - frosted-glass blur leg, default none

accessibility.keyboard: ArrowUp/Down move between visible rows, Home/End jump, ArrowRight expands a sub-menu and ArrowLeft collapses it (mirrored in RTL), Enter activates the focused row
accessibility.semantics: rows are buttons with their label and selected state; collapsed icons expose tooltips with the row label

sizes.row: 32 px row height, 16 px icon, 12 px muted group label

notes: The same widget renders as a fixed column on desktop and inside an openDrawer builder on phone widths; the navigation list scrolls internally.
Sub-menu children render one level deep under an expanded parent; the parent's tap toggles the sub-menu and reports selection.
